Partly built

Language teacher and the pupils

A teacher will be found on the directory, parents will get a room per pupil, and progress will arrive as receipts.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. FactThe teacher no tool neededDeclares what she teaches and offers, as public facts.
  2. EventA parent no tool neededFinds her on the directory and asks for a place.
  3. PlanThe room via person outsideOne room per pupil: parent, pupil, teacher and her assistant.
  4. ProposalHer assistant via modelProposes the weekly progress note to the parent.
  5. ReceiptThe lesson via a personEach lesson is a deliverable with a hold; the receipt feeds her profile.
What you get
Starts withA teacher
StatusPartly built
Lessons given, progress notes, and published receipts on her profile.

What it keeps to

  • A public fact is public only because she set it so.
  • Money is held until the lesson is verified.
  • Each pupil's room is private to its members.
